description: This file defines a Java interface 'InlineExecutorService' with generic type T that declares methods for executing inline jobs. It includes method signatures without implementations, meant to be implemented elsewhere in the project.

classes.name: InlineExecutorService
classes.description: A generic Java interface for executing inline jobs, providing methods for executing a list of elements, a single element, and an execution method that returns a CommandProcessingResult.

methods.name: executeInlineJob
methods.description: Executes an inline job based on a JSON command and a job name, returning a CommandProcessingResult.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes a list of elements with the specified job name.

methods.name: execute (default method)
methods.description: Executes a single element by wrapping it in a singleton list and passing to the bulk execute method.
